$comment: DRAFT NICE Plus work role. Not a NIST product. Core/additional flags and added statements are nice-plus judgments, not NIST's. Statements were chosen by relevance to the role, not from coverage tags.
title: Chief Operational Technology Officer
description: DRAFT. OT specialization of NICE work role OG-WRL-007 (Executive Cybersecurity Leadership). The executive accountable for the security and resilience of the organization's operational technology: sets OT cybersecurity strategy, governance and risk tolerance, and makes sure security is built into operations, engineering, capital projects and procurement. Some organizations give this to a CISO or a VP of operations or engineering.

citations.note: Parent NICE role; all its statements are inherited.
Security program requirements for asset owners.

open_questions: Is this a distinct executive role, or a set of OT duties added to the CISO (OG-WRL-007)?
Who owns OT security in practice: operations, engineering, or IT security? The answer shapes the core list.

inherit.rationale: Inferred: strategy, risk, resourcing, continuity and critical-infrastructure statements are core; intelligence, legal and IT-specific statements are additional.

add_nice.rationale: Inferred: OT cybersecurity risk tolerance levels.
Inferred: Control system risks, threats and vulnerabilities.
Inferred: Cyber incidents that have affected OT.
Inferred: Communicating implications of new OT technologies to stakeholders.
